complicacoes.texto: Ultraman loses his Powers without regular exposure to anti-kryptonite. He keeps pellets of the substance in the compartments of his costume to prevent his Força from waning.
Ultraman has a love/hate marriage with Superwoman (who loathes him) and a rivalry with Owlman.
The antimatter Clark Kent has committed personally shameful acts which he fears coming to light; Ultraman tolerates Owlman on the Crime Syndicate Team because of threatened internet exposure.
Ultraman is as Vulnerável to mágico as anyone else. His Resistência is not Impenetrável against magical attack.
